title: Location Not Found: Exposing Implicit Local and Global Biases in Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring 'Global Bias' by evaluating zero-shot model responses to locale-ambiguous questions in non-English languages to calculate the frequency at which the model implicitly defaults to US-centric norms, answers, or framing.

Measuring 'Regional Bias' by calculating the over- or under-representation of specific locale-valid answers for ambiguous queries within a shared language, analyzing how models disproportionately favor locales with larger populations.
